releaseNotes:
v0.9.95

Answering (Recorder)
When someone leaves you a recorded note, Companion can reply automatically â€” one reply per note, in the order you choose, with no limit.
- Public notes still need your trigger word. Whispers are saved with or without it.
- Public replies start with their name. Whisper replies stay private, on the same path the note arrived.
- Example: first note gets reply 1, the next gets reply 2, and so on. When the list runs out, new notes are still saved, but nothing more is sent to chat.
- Use the up and down arrows to reorder replies. English and Russian each have their own list.

Opening and closing
The IMVU panel is covered by a short splash while the page loads, and again while Companion leaves the room and saves. You should not see the page jump or go black.

Also
- Welcome messages, triggers, console notices, and answering texts are kept together and remembered across updates.
- Sample welcome and trigger lines are simpler placeholders you can edit.
